title: RuoYi 若依管理系统 默认弱密码漏洞
description: RuoYi (若依) is a popular Java-based administrative web platform widely deployed across university administrative portals and student services. The system ships with default credentials (admin/admin123) that are frequently left unchanged in production deployments. An attacker can access the administrative backend at /login or /admin and authenticate with these default credentials. Upon successful authentication, the attacker gains administrative control over the student portal, including user management, role assignment, and access to internal databases.
remediation:
1. Force credential rotation on initial deployment
2. Enforce strong password complexity policy (minimum 12 chars, mixed case, symbols)
3. Enable CAPTCHA and rate limiting on /login endpoint
4. Implement account lockout after 5 consecutive failed attempts
5. Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for administrative accounts

title: Apache Shiro 路径穿越认证绕过漏洞 (CVE-2020-1957)
description: Apache Shiro before 1.5.2 allows authentication bypass when combined with Spring Boot. Due to discrepancies in how Spring and Apache Shiro handle URI parsing and normalization, an unauthenticated attacker can append /..;/ or manipulate URL paths (e.g., /resource/..;/admin/index) to bypass access control filters. In educational web environments where Shiro guards student grading and faculty portals, this allows unauthorized access to restricted endpoints.
remediation:
1. Upgrade Apache Shiro to version 1.7.0 or later
2. Implement URL normalization in custom web filters before Shiro evaluation
3. Adopt Spring Security with modern path matching mechanisms
4. Conduct thorough authorization matrix testing across all administrative endpoints

title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI 远程代码执行漏洞 (CVE-2021-44228)
description: Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 to 2.14.1 fail to protect against attacker-controlled JNDI lookups. Message lookup substitution allows arbitrary code execution via crafted ${jndi:ldap://...} or ${jndi:rmi://...} payloads sent in HTTP headers (User-Agent, X-Forwarded-For) or input fields. In campus library systems and university portal loggers, this grants immediate shell execution under the application server context.
remediation:
1. Upgrade Log4j to >= 2.17.1
2. Set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true as JVM argument if upgrade cannot be performed immediately
3. Remove JndiLookup class from log4j-core JAR files
4. Restrict outbound egress traffic (specifically LDAP and RMI ports 389, 636, 1099) from application servers

title: Spring Cloud Function SpEL 远程命令执行漏洞 (CVE-2022-22963)
description: When Spring Cloud Function routing is enabled, HTTP header 'spring.cloud.function.routing-expression' evaluates SpEL (Spring Expression Language) expressions without proper sandboxing. An attacker sending a crafted SpEL payload via HTTP POST can execute arbitrary operating system commands on the server hosting educational microservices.
remediation:
1. Upgrade Spring Cloud Function to version 3.1.7 or 3.2.3+
2. Implement WAF rules filtering SpEL expressions in HTTP headers
3. Run microservices in containerized environments with minimal privileges and read-only filesystems

title: ThinkPHP 5.0.23 远程代码执行漏洞
description: ThinkPHP 5.0.23 does not properly filter method parameters in Request class when capturing parameters via $_POST. By utilizing the captcha handler or invokable methods, an unauthenticated attacker can invoke arbitrary PHP functions including system(), exec(), and assert() to execute system commands on educational courseware websites.
remediation:
1. Upgrade ThinkPHP to the latest secure release (5.0.24+ or 6.x)
2. Apply the official parameter check patch in think/Request.php
3. Disable dangerous PHP functions (system, exec, passthru, shell_exec) in php.ini

title: RuoYi 若依管理系统 后台部门管理 SQL注入漏洞 (CVE-2021-43700)
description: RuoYi management platform versions prior to 4.6.2 contain a SQL injection vulnerability in the department management component (/system/dept/edit). Due to dynamic string concatenation in MyBatis XML configuration files (using ${params.dataScope} instead of #{}), authenticated or privileged attackers can inject arbitrary SQL queries to extract sensitive university student data, grades, and hashes.
remediation:
1. Replace dynamic ${} variable interpolation with parameterized #{} bindings in MyBatis mapper XML files
2. Upgrade RuoYi platform to version >= 4.6.2
3. Deploy database firewall / SQL monitoring to block suspicious SQL functions (sleep, benchmark, union select)

title: Apache Tomcat Manager 默认弱密码部署漏洞
description: Apache Tomcat server installations for university departmental servers frequently leave the /manager/html interface accessible with default credentials such as tomcat/tomcat or admin/admin configured in tomcat-users.xml. Attackers authenticating to this interface can deploy malicious WAR packages to achieve remote code execution and full server compromise.
remediation:
1. Restrict /manager and /host-manager access via RemoteAddrValve to localhost only
2. Remove default roles and accounts from tomcat-users.xml
3. Enforce high-entropy randomized passwords if remote management is required
4. Remove unused sample applications and manager webapps in production

title: Alibaba Druid 监控平台未授权访问漏洞
description: Alibaba Druid connection pool provides an embedded web console (/druid/index.html) displaying database connection statistics, SQL execution logs, and session details. When StatViewServlet is deployed without authentication filters or IP whitelisting in educational web applications, external attackers can view executed SQL statements, user sessions, and database schemas.
remediation:
1. Configure loginUsername and loginPassword parameters for Druid StatViewServlet
2. Set allow and deny IP restrictions in web.xml or Spring Boot configuration
3. Disable Druid monitoring console in production environments

source_path: 身份认证漏洞/JWT-弱密钥篡改.md
title: 教育单点登录平台 JWT 弱密钥与签名篡改漏洞
description: Educational single sign-on (SSO) and student portal APIs using JWT for stateless authentication frequently employ predictable HMAC secret keys (e.g., 'secret', '123456', or platform names). Attackers can brute-force the HMAC secret key offline, forge tokens with elevated student-to-admin privileges, or exploit algorithmic 'none' vulnerabilities to bypass authentication entirely.
remediation:
1. Use cryptographically secure keys (minimum 256-bit entropy for HS256 or asymmetric RS256/Ed25519)
2. Explicitly verify algorithms in JWT parser to prevent 'none' algorithm bypass
3. Implement short token lifetimes (15-60 minutes) coupled with secure refresh token rotation
4. Store tokens with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict cookie flags

source_path: 敏感信息泄露/Git-源码泄露.md
title: 高校信息系统 .git 源码泄露漏洞
description: Due to improper web server configuration during website deployment, the hidden /.git directory is left publicly accessible on campus web servers. Attackers using tools like GitHack can recover the entire application source code, configuration files containing database credentials, API secret keys, and internal network architecture.
remediation:
1. Add server block rules in Nginx/Apache denying access to hidden files and directories (location ~ /\.git { deny all; })
2. Ensure deployment automation strips .git metadata from the web root
3. Regularly run automated scans on educational domains to detect exposed repository files

source_path: 敏感信息泄露/Swagger-API文档暴露.md
title: 高校教务系统 Swagger UI / OpenAPI 敏感接口未授权暴露
description: Educational platform backends built with Spring Boot often leave Swagger documentation endpoints (/swagger-ui.html, /v2/api-docs, /v3/api-docs) publicly accessible without authentication. Attackers inspect all REST API contracts, parameter requirements, internal microservice endpoints, and test endpoints, facilitating targeted authorization bypass and data extraction attacks.
remediation:
1. Disable Swagger in production environments using Spring profiles (@Profile('!prod'))
2. Implement strict authentication and authorization filters over /swagger-ui and /v3/api-docs paths
3. Ensure internal administrative APIs are not documented in publicly exposed OpenAPI definitions

title: Spring Boot Actuator 未授权端点敏感信息泄露
description: When Spring Boot Actuator endpoints are exposed without security controls (management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=*), external visitors can access /actuator/env and /actuator/heapdump. These endpoints leak environment variables, database passwords, cloud API tokens, and complete JVM memory dumps containing user credentials and session tokens in educational portals.
remediation:
1. Restrict management endpoint exposure to health only: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info
2. Secure actuator endpoints behind Spring Security authentication
3. Bind actuator management port to internal localhost interface only
